title: Keep writer overlap bookkeeping for an external Dart start without a Codex item ID
outcome: An external Dart start that lacks a usable provider item ID still participates in ordinary writer overlap and command bookkeeping while remaining ineligible for external launch custody.
acceptance: A production-path Codex command start carrying a supported external focused Dart command without a usable item ID still fences overlapping open checks and records the ordinary command lifecycle, but cannot take external Test receipt custody. A valid identified external launch still settles through its own original start and end.
